document_text:
Court
-----
Meridian Vale Civil Court

Division and Courtroom
----------------------
Civil Division C, Courtroom 1

Matter Number
-------------
MVC-27-64660

Order Date
----------
29 March 2027

Recorded Events
---------------
the close of fact discovery    19 May 2027
service of written discovery   not recorded

Deadlines Ordered
-----------------
1. Each party shall serve the opposition to dispositive motions within 90 days of the date of this Order.

2. Each party shall file the joint status report no later than 3 October 2027.

3. Within 15 business days after service of written discovery, the parties shall file dispositive motions.

4. The requirement that the pretrial statement be served within 14 business days after the case management conference is WITHDRAWN and sets no date here.

5. The parties shall serve the pretrial statement within 35 days after the close of fact discovery. (the parties calculate this as 24 July 2027)

6. Within 20 days of the date of this Order, the parties shall exchange the witness list.
